negative_reviews.author: Adriana Baranowska
negative_reviews.text: i was eating at maki and ramen twice. first time about a year ago, and the food was amazingly tasty. but today we ordered chicken ramen and poer ramen and it was so disapointing, not warm enough, not tasty at all, just a lot of noodles and the liquid did not have any particular taste. Really I took my three guests there, but next time we won't chose maki and ramen. the egg was cold just on the top of my plate. no no no, in general much worse experience.

negative_reviews.author: M Yhaya
negative_reviews.text: Ordered the steak tataki, I know they cook the steak rare but it was the chewiest piece of rubber ive ever tasted. It was a shame because the broth and noodles were delicious, as was the karaage.

negative_reviews.author: Mia
negative_reviews.text:
Had the black garlic tonkotsu; tasted a bit average, possibly from a stock cube as it was not thick and didnt have the deepest flavour, the oil tasted more flavoursome and the egg was not steeped just a plain boiled egg.
Hidden behind the price is a service charge (hence the low service score as its just not needed for the level of service, additionally will say the staff were just on their phones sat in the booth, a bit unprofessional and makes the atmosphere a bit meh)

For ramen and a can of pop it came to £19.80 which felt a bit overpriced. Will try elsewhere next time. Overall okay meal and was satisfied but expected better quality for the price.

negative_reviews.author: Suhale Malik
negative_reviews.text: Nice restaurant, quality of Ramen not the best for the price. Mr Sus Noodles and Dumplings are much nicer IMO. Give them a try if you get a chance :)
